beats.visibleGoal: 開始、繼續、或設定。第一次遊玩直接走進暴雨，不要先讀世界觀。
beats.goal30s: 按開始之後站在維修台上。
beats.verb: Choose New / Continue / Settings in a semantic DOM shell.
beats.verb90s: First play is already walking P-S00.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Restraint: no lore wall, no classroom crawl, no pre-test. WebGL-less machines get a DOM block, not a black void.
beats.failureConsequence: Missing WebGL → 「無法啟動 3D」 plus settings. Continue with no save behaves as New.
beats.recovery: Settings persist in localStorage. New always spawns P-S00.
beats.noQuizBypass: Title is not a biology pre-test and not a disclaimer lecture.
beats.hudTask: 開始 / 繼續 / 設定

space.sightline: No destination render until P-S00
space.circulation: First play → black rain audio → ext.service_deck

structureBorrow.method: Cold start into weather, Hub later

No developer-voice 這是教學故事 on boot

beats.visibleGoal: 走到中央桌。兩扇同等的門：去河港，或試一次微觀工作坊。
beats.goal30s: Player can point at both physical entries.
beats.verb: Walk a real floor. Interact with a door volume, not a chapter list.
beats.verb90s: Stand at the briefing table and choose a door by walking into it.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Equal scale, light, and dignity on harbor vs workshop. After C1 the skyline window shows the chosen monitoring furniture and the first-fail plaque is on the tool wall.
beats.failureConsequence: C2 hatch stays shut and may play 何主任 radio after C1. It never loads a factory.
beats.recovery: Both doors remain usable. Workshop leave mid-scene writes workshop.resumeScene only.
beats.noQuizBypass: Harbor is legal with workshop.complete === false. No 未完成基礎 lock, no skip-shame modal.
beats.hudTask: 走到中央桌，選一扇門

space.sightline: Table is the first readable cluster from the P-S06 fade-in
space.circulation: Free walk; two load volumes; stub hatch

After C1, skyline matches world.harbor.monitoringModel

beats.visibleGoal: 到防洪控制室。高處閘門停著，下方每隔三秒閃小岑的橙色求救燈。
beats.goal30s: Untutored player says 救人 / 到上面的閘 / 控制室 — not 學生物.
beats.verb: Walk the amber service spine. Auto step-up a 20 cm pipe. Look through the glass slit.
beats.verb90s: Past the glass with Gate 3 and the SOS still in frame.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Dual attractors: warm indoor door (allowed, wrong) vs high cold gate. Spine is the only route that grows the SOS in frame. Indoor wall map lights ~8 m of yellow if they wander.
beats.failureConsequence: Fall → safety line 1.2 s to last amber anchor. Look away 3 s → 方雅 radio. Linger 12 s → 小岑 jab.
beats.recovery: Rope. Indoor door opens; 方雅 redirects; no death screen, no HP.
beats.noQuizBypass: No which-way multiple choice. Scene cannot complete without walking to the dead lift.
beats.hudTask: 到防洪控制室

space.sightline: Default camera: gate 12–18 m up, 80–120 m out; SOS period 3 s

structureBorrow.method: See the high destination before any bible

evidence.seen: Stopped sluice + orange SOS + rising water through glass
evidence.claim: Walk the yellow line, not the indoor refuge
evidence.revision: Indoor wander still allowed; map lights the short route

qa: Mute VO + hide subtitles: 4/5 still walk toward gate/SOS
Fall never shows a death screen

beats.visibleGoal: 電梯沒電。推開擋住右邊維修梯的工具箱，爬上去。
beats.goal30s: Push the crate, climb the ladder.
beats.verb: Interact-shove a light crate. Climb a low ladder. Enter the dark booth crack.
beats.verb90s: Hands on the single-button handheld.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Crate occupies the ladder volume. Climb is a 2.4–3.0 m low vault. Camera eases in and never steals control. Handheld is the only lit desk object.
beats.failureConsequence: Crate shoved off-axis still blocks if it intersects the climb volume.
beats.recovery: Shove again. No timer. No enemies.
beats.noQuizBypass: A Use Ladder prompt on a blocked volume is a fail. Collision stays blocked until the crate moves.
beats.hudTask: 推開工具箱，爬右邊的梯

space.sightline: Ladder visible as soon as the lift cage is reached

structureBorrow.method: First interact in zero threat

qa: Ladder unusable until crate leaves its volume

beats.visibleGoal: 用桌上的透鏡叫醒維修標記。跟會流動的那條，不是最亮的死線。
beats.goal30s: Hold, aim at the wall, release. See three runs.
beats.verb: Flow Lens pulse. Follow moving glow around an occluding panel. Press the loose relay home.
beats.verb90s: First useful pulse has shown direction versus dead shine.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Three-Run Wall. Top = brightest dead reflector, fades ~1 s. Mid = dimmer live flow toward the lock, then behind a panel. Bottom = dull dummy. Occlusion is the puzzle. First pulse free; then battery ring with no definition text.
beats.failureConsequence: Follow the flare → line dies, lock stays dark. Empty battery → pulse refuses, ring blinks.
beats.recovery: Repulse. Live run still moves. Wait for battery. First pulse remains free so the lesson is readable.
beats.noQuizBypass: Clicking or highlighting all three pipes does nothing. Only seating the live relay opens the lock. No pick-the-correct-line list.
beats.hudTask: 對著牆按住再放開；沿著會流動的線走

space.sightline: All three pipes readable from the desk
space.circulation: Pulse → sidestep panel → seat relay → lock lights; outer span is already out

structureBorrow.method: Signal, not waypoint; instrument can show false shine

evidence.consequence: Lock lights; Cut Span is the next gap

qa: Brightest run never opens the lock
Live run is occluded after the first metre of particles

beats.visibleGoal: 抓住牆上的連接工具，把兩塊板拉來，扣進兩個形狀座，走過去。
beats.goal30s: Grab Tether. Move the first plate.
beats.verb: Tether pull, push, rotate, snap-by-shape.
beats.verb90s: First plate seated or clearly failing to seat on a wrong pose.
beats.spatialPuzzle: 1.0 m gap; jump is illegal (rope back). Plate A light, one pose seats in a chevron socket. Plate B heavier, slower rotate, wind gusts. Sockets are silhouette, not color. After crossing, plate A lifts in the wind but the lock holds.
beats.failureConsequence: Drop → safety cable returns plate to the rack. Fall → rope to the near lip. Wrong pose: no snap.
beats.recovery: Cable / rope. Assist mode auto-aligns near ~15° and 20 cm.
beats.noQuizBypass: No click-to-place. Distance, rotation, and socket shape are required. Color-only sockets fail the script.
beats.hudTask: 把板拉過來，扣進形狀座

space.sightline: Gap and far lip visible as soon as the lock opens
space.circulation: Rack → span → far lip; no legal jump

structureBorrow.method: Mass, drop, recover

qa: Wrong rotation never snaps
Dropped plate returns to rack, not despawn

beats.visibleGoal: 電在，命令沒有到。找斷點，讓閘門聽見一次。
beats.goal30s: Pulse the gallery; see command stop.
beats.verb: Combine Flow Lens and Tether: find the stop, clear, re-seat or re-route.
beats.verb90s: At least one relay state has changed by hand.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Three faults, three heights, free order. Wrong-path relay seated on a dummy bus. Jammed relay behind debris. Loose relay hanging. Each fix stacks a mechanical audio layer. Last snap raises Gate 3 and turns the water; 小岑 deck slips.
beats.failureConsequence: Dummy-bus seat lights the wrong loop; actuator silent. No 「正確」 toast.
beats.recovery: Unplug and route to the actuator run. Debris re-grabbable.
beats.noQuizBypass: A three-item look-at checklist is illegal. Gate moves only when all three electrical/mechanical states are true.
beats.hudTask: 找斷點，清開，再接

space.sightline: Gate 3 and slipping deck readable from the booth glass

structureBorrow.method: Combine two taught verbs under mild pressure

evidence.seen: Command stop on the pulse; dummy loop versus actuator run
evidence.consequence: Gate rises; water direction changes; evac starts

qa: World audio stacks per fix
UI never prints 正確

beats.visibleGoal: 沿白色脈衝跑到救援台，按住升降梯，把小岑拉上來。
beats.goal30s: See the old span is unusable and the new white-pulse cut.
beats.verb: Sprint. Pulse if lost. Tether the missing lever. Hold the lift until 小岑 rises.
beats.verb90s: Inside the return cut, not still in the booth.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Cut Span first plate lifts (lock holds) so the taught bridge is gone. New side corridor exists only because the gate moved. Lever is on the floor; door will not close the circuit without it. Lift is a hold, not a tap.
beats.failureConsequence: Standard 70 s to hold-start. Water first → mist wipe, 方雅 lock, restart at corridor mouth. Relaxed timer: no hard fail, water stays theatrical.
beats.recovery: Lever stays seated. Completed tethers stay. 小岑: 閘替我擋了一次。再來。
beats.noQuizBypass: No booth Rescue button. Path is gated by the lever door.
beats.hudTask: 跟白色脈衝走，啟動升降梯

space.sightline: White pulse readable from gallery exit
space.circulation: Booth → new cut → lever door → lift

structureBorrow.method: Extract through weather; tools are the lifeline

qa: Relaxed timer still finishes the story
Water-first does not reset the lever

beats.visibleGoal: 看三號閘重新運作。標題出現。走進大廳，選河港或工作坊。
beats.goal30s: Sit-down, then title 生命迴路：澄灣.
beats.verb: Watch, then walk into Hub control. Choose a physical door.
beats.verb90s: Controllable on hub.floor.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Breather. Title lands after competence, not before. Two Hub doors of equal dignity.
beats.failureConsequence: None.
beats.noQuizBypass: No recap quiz. Skip workshop shows no warning and writes no unqualified flag.

space.sightline: Gate working outside

beats.visibleGoal: 拉下縮放手柄，走進放大的細胞。看清楚外殼、長軌、軌上的短段。
beats.goal30s: Stand inside the translucent cell.
beats.verb: Pull scale handle. Lens boundary, rail, marked stretch. Tether the magnifier frame, never the DNA. Aim three exit frames in order.
beats.verb90s: Scale-in complete; rail is readable as a bolted track.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Inclusion as space: cell volume ⊃ rail length ⊃ short marked gene. Exit plays cell → DNA → gene only when aim-order is correct. DNA is rack-bolted.
beats.failureConsequence: Wrong aim order: frames dim, door stays. Grab DNA: lock icon, rail does not move.
beats.recovery: Re-aim. Safe pad returns to Hub and sets workshop.resumeScene = W-S00.
beats.noQuizBypass: Three labeled buttons are illegal. Door reads camera aim + order, not A/B/C/D.
beats.hudTask: 對準外殼、長軌、短段

space.sightline: Cell hangs in the well before scale-in

structureBorrow.method: One idea in a safe volume

qa: DNA cannot be pulled off the rack

beats.visibleGoal: 讓讀取頭沿短段走出一份可以帶走的新軌。舊軌留在架上。
beats.goal30s: Start the reader; see a second rail peel.
beats.verb: Start reader. Tether RNA to the next station. Refuse DNA grabs.
beats.verb90s: RNA exists as a carryable single rail.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Two rails, two rights. DNA welded. RNA free. Wrong station: RNA tip keeps streaming toward the fold ring.
beats.failureConsequence: Wrong dock: no snap, glow keeps pointing. DNA grab: lock icon.
beats.recovery: Follow the glow. Leave on safe pad; resume W-S01.
beats.noQuizBypass: Cannot select transcription from a list. Next room stays empty until an RNA rail arrives.
beats.hudTask: 把新的單軌帶到下一站

beats.visibleGoal: 看珠鏈折好，把它放進會轉動的鎖。RNA 對不準。
beats.goal30s: See the chain fold on the ring.
beats.verb: Walk the ring. Seat the folded protein. Optionally offer RNA to prove the mismatch.
beats.verb90s: Barrel has turned, or RNA mismatch has been seen.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Shape lock. Protein keyway turns the barrel. RNA silhouette will not seat.
beats.failureConsequence: RNA in lock: visible mismatch, barrel still.
beats.recovery: Take RNA back. Protein remains.
beats.noQuizBypass: No which-molecule cards. The lock is a 3D keyway.

beats.visibleGoal: 先看沒有煙霧時燈為什麼暗；再開煙，跟著訊號走到旗。把燈換成形狀旗。
beats.goal30s: Dark run: gate shut, lamp dark.
beats.verb: Run dark. Tether-open smoke. Pulse sensor → regulator → promoter → reporter. Swap lamp for a shape flag.
beats.verb90s: Smoke is on and the chain is being traced.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Four world objects in a line plus a delayed reporter spool. Flag swap proves output form ≠ sensing logic.
beats.failureConsequence: Skipping the dark run: hall still forces a no-input cycle before smoke is accepted.
beats.recovery: Close smoke, run dark again. Always legal.
beats.noQuizBypass: Naming promoter from a list does not open the door. Door wants dark run + smoke run + flag swap.
beats.hudTask: 開煙霧，追訊號，換成形狀旗

space.sightline: Whole chain readable from the dark-run pad
space.circulation: Linear, one way, swap at the tower

beats.visibleGoal: 月亮該暗、太陽該亮。太陽也暗時，不要讀問號。
beats.goal30s: First run: all three dark.
beats.verb: Run. Pulse the broken sun joint. Tether-repair. Run again. Only then read ?
beats.verb90s: Player has tried the run and seen the sun fail.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Authored-broken first run. Flow Lens shows the sun coupler open. ? hatch collision stays solid until moon dark AND sun bright. Second run: moon dark, sun bright, ? mid/fluctuating.
beats.failureConsequence: ? hatch does not move. That is the lesson, not a scold.
beats.recovery: Fix joint, re-run. Exit sealed until the pair is valid.
beats.noQuizBypass: Cannot skip to a definition of control. Cannot treat ?-dark as river-empty. Failed positive control blocks unknown — same hard rule as C1-S03.
beats.hudTask: 先修好太陽通道，再看問號

space.sightline: Three icons readable before any term

structureBorrow.method: The room is broken on purpose so the verb is diagnosis

qa: ? cannot open the exit on the first run

beats.visibleGoal: 看見自己剛做過的圈：問、組、跑、斷、修、再測。然後回大廳。
beats.goal30s: Desk replay is running.
beats.verb: Watch the shrink + replay. Walk back to Hub.
beats.verb90s: Controllable toward the Hub door.
beats.spatialPuzzle: No new verb. Shrink proves the model wing is the same station.
beats.failureConsequence: Leave early: workshop.complete stays false. Legal.
beats.recovery: Re-enter from Hub; resume this scene.
beats.noQuizBypass: No DBTL four-letter exam. Names are not a password. Completing this does not lock or unlock C1.

beats.visibleGoal: 帶封閉探頭去東岸，追第一次訊號。桌上選電池或抗撞外殼，只能帶一件。
beats.goal30s: Find the repeating alarm’s direction so 郭工’s team can walk safely.
beats.verb: Pick sealed probe. Pick one loadout. Walk to the east-shore airlock.
beats.verb90s: Probe in hand, loadout chosen, map wall glanced.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Loadout is a physical claim about risk, not a moral test. Map wall shows three time-stamped blinks and dark public stations. No vials, no A/B/C/D pins.
beats.failureConsequence: Second loadout object snaps back. Airlock stays shut without the probe.
beats.recovery: Either loadout completes the chapter. Dialogue only forks on workshop.complete (D003 vs D003A).
beats.noQuizBypass: No which-module-is-the-sensor test. No sample-candidate cards. 方雅 states the permission split: carry device + route; 郭工 confirms.
beats.hudTask: 沿東岸步道追蹤第一次訊號

space.sightline: Foggy harbor through storm glass

structureBorrow.method: Prepare one tool, then leave the Hub

qa: Both loadouts exist; neither is labelled 正確

beats.visibleGoal: 轉身體，看三角形何時跳得更密。把完整記錄帶到泵房側面。
beats.goal30s: Probe awake; triangle is filling; player is rotating.
beats.verb: Pulse. Aim sealed probe with the body. Tether float crates. Cage the probe over a cable.
beats.verb90s: A heading has changed triangle density. Player is off the first pad.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Market back-cut, pump crown, finger pier, soak tunnel. Lure: warehouse civic red, brighter, still. Truth: weak pulse against current. Fish / oil / smell are observations, not pollution stamps. Probe shock: shell stays up; battery needs wall power 10 s.
beats.failureConsequence: Warehouse fence: no record slot. Probe in water: bob + Tether; untreated shock uses the loadout rule.
beats.recovery: Both loadouts can finish. Record writes only at the pump-side jack after a direction-stable heading.
beats.noQuizBypass: No three candidate sites with one green check. The warehouse exists to punish click-all. Carrying a record is the claim.
beats.hudTask: 跟著三角形變密的方向走，帶回完整記錄

space.circulation: Promenade with optional lure branch that dead-ends

beats.visibleGoal: 工具每個方向都一樣滿。先親自試三件事，再把整支探頭帶回高地流動站。
beats.goal30s: Saturation is visible as max triangle every facing.
beats.verb: Must try: turn in place, leave the slot, kill the env relay. Then carry the whole probe. Evac the roof.
beats.verb90s: At least one of the three tests has been performed after saturation.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Authored saturation ~60 s in. Mission flip is code-gated on triedTurn && triedLeave && triedKillRelay. Tide kills the pier. Battery evac = short lift. Shell evac = shorter carry over a beam. Times similar.
beats.failureConsequence: Overstay → 郭工 remote lock, fade to van mouth, probe kept, no blame. Treating max-everywhere as river-wide concentration is a hypothesis the next room breaks.
beats.recovery: Appear at High-Bench. Invalid run already in evidence.runHistory and cannot be deleted.
beats.noQuizBypass: A dialogue line the tool is broken must not skip the three tests. Flip is not a quiz grade.
beats.hudTask: 先停。帶回完整探頭

beats.visibleGoal: 月亮低、太陽高之後，才准看問號。
beats.goal30s: Three docks are out. Moon should stay low.
beats.verb: Dock moon. Dock sun (still max = not restored). Lens self-test. External-port reset regulator relay. Swap sealed wet reporter joint. Re-run pair. Then ?
beats.verb90s: Sun has been docked and is visibly wrong.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Van side-rack. Icons first; small labels only if workshop complete. Shell never opens. ? collision off until moon low AND sun high. ? then mid + fluctuation. UI: two control states + session clock. Never 100% 準確.
beats.failureConsequence: ? stays solid while sun is wrong. First fail remains on the paper roll.
beats.recovery: Ports remain. 方雅 forbids delete. Second harbor airlock stays shut until c1.controlsRestored.
beats.noQuizBypass: Cannot select positive control from a list. Cannot publish a harbor claim from this van. Same hard gate as W-S04 even if workshop was skipped.

beats.visibleGoal: 用兩個 relay 加手上的探頭，交出一塊確認隊能走進的範圍。不要一個紅點。
beats.goal30s: Tide has sealed the market road. Roofs and crane are the new way.
beats.verb: Place up to two beacons. Walk the third reading. Accept an overlap. Optional: take 陳姨’s unmapped sluice.
beats.verb90s: First beacon is singing or in hand on the crane span.
beats.spatialPuzzle: No painted triad. Overlap from headings + quality (occlusion lowers quality). Near/occluded vs far/exposed. Wide/fast vs far/tight both write c1.sourceZoneMarked. Crane drop → Tether retrieve. 陳姨 radio opens a dark cut the official decal missed.
beats.failureConsequence: Pocket-both or zero-quality overlap cannot be accepted. Dropped beacon is retrieved, not lost.
beats.recovery: Re-place. First-trace overlay stays so S01 is not repeated.
beats.noQuizBypass: Three sample wells with one correct well are illegal. The claim is a polygon the player made. Confirm time later differs; there is no score.
beats.hudTask: 標出確認隊能安全進入的範圍

space.sightline: First-trace overlay on the field map

structureBorrow.method: Knowledge (Chen) opens geometry; no four glowing waypoints

qa: No three painted wells
Both strategies complete the scene

beats.visibleGoal: 讓站在棚下、推車後面的人看得見、聽得到，並知道下一步和誰更新。
beats.goal30s: Demo probe is at the market mouth. 陳姨 starts walking.
beats.verb: Walk behind 陳姨. Change workbench props. Walk again.
beats.verb90s: Shade has already killed a color-only read, or the cart has hidden a low panel.
beats.spatialPuzzle: Playable usability test, not a cutscene. Shade kills color-only. Cart occludes knee-height panel. Text that only says 紅 starts NPC guessing. Workbench: shape flag, short chime, action line, municipal board + timestamp. Second walk must succeed.
beats.failureConsequence: Missing visible channel / next action / owner+time → specific confusion. Scene cannot complete. 陳姨 will not call it usable.
beats.recovery: Change on the spot. Re-walk is instant. No affinity meter.
beats.noQuizBypass: Honesty cards, I-will-communicate-better dialogue, or a compliment cutscene with the same prototype are Learning Gate fails. Pass requires shape_audio AND municipal_update_with_timestamp.
beats.hudTask: 改輸出和通知，再跟陳姨走一次
